scope: Final strict generated-JS experiment preparation and real-worker checksum verification only. No formal timing, memory comparison, no-regression result, public syntax migration or release gate is claimed.

replay.environment: Install locked dependencies in each independent checkout, use the same recorded Clang/WASI inputs, and build all TypeScript before native artifact creation. Keep the tested candidate checkout clean; read reports from a separate evidence checkout.
candidateCommands: A0_JS_SOURCE_ARTIFACT=.a0-tmp/js-final A0_JS_SOURCE_DIRECT_ARTIFACT=.a0-tmp/direct-final A0_JS_SOURCE_RENDERER=.a0-tmp/diagnostic-final node --test --test-name-pattern="JS artifact loading|prepared JS provenance" dist/test/source-js.controls.js
replay.smoke: Write smokeRunner.source byte-for-byte to .a0-tmp/strict-worker-smoke.mjs inside the clean candidate checkout, then run: node .a0-tmp/strict-worker-smoke.mjs .a0-tmp/js-cost-final-preparation .a0-tmp/js-final "$C_ARTIFACT" "$C_CONTROL_CHECKOUT" "$HISTORICAL_CHECKOUT" .a0-tmp/js-worker-final-checksums.json
replay.identity: Raw manifest and worker-proof hashes depend on the local excluded dist path emitted by tsc --showConfig. Rebuild them at the new checkout; published path-normalized inspection copies are not executable worker proofs.

phaseAccounting.frontend: Instantiation, upload, parsing/checking and typed-IR decoding; first-call JS JIT remains included.
phaseAccounting.pipeline: Frontend plus the same fixed historical C emitter.
phaseAccounting.modulePreparation: Exact artifact/SDK checks, fresh ESM import, Wasm compilation and the post-load immutable-proof checks, outside frontend/pipeline and inside child wall.
phaseAccounting.postCheck: Final immutable-code/artifact checks outside frontend/pipeline and inside child wall.
phaseAccounting.memory: Worker fields retain RSS/peak RSS, JS heap used/total, external and array-buffer counters. JS Wasm-linear memory is arena-only; it excludes JS heap, generated code, JIT and GC. Smoke numeric observations are checked for presence and discarded.

limits: No formal quiet comparison has run for generated JS; a separate authorized quiet window and new output directory are required.
No same-process warm cohort or total-engine-memory equivalence is established.
The existing per-word record/page copies and JS/Wasm transitions are unchanged.
The same 240-second worker timeout remains in force.
Public source routing, compiler targets, A0 modules and backend lowering are unchanged by this harness.
The full repository and supported-platform release gates remain required before publication.
